selectionOutcomes.description: Entry documents unauthenticated access and resolves the supplied share token through the active-share helper.
Loads the exact memo identified by the resolved share and rejects missing, non-normal, or SPACE-audience memos.
Builds a read context using the shared memo ID and maps context errors or access denial to NOT_FOUND.
Converts and returns the memo, maps a missing creator to NOT_FOUND, and removes the surrounding relation graph.
Looks up the supplied token and rejects absent or expired shares as NOT_FOUND; datastore errors are INTERNAL.
Defines expiration from ExpiresTs and the current Unix time.
Shows that share existence and token resolution are delegated to the store driver using the supplied finder.
Resolves the current viewer; for an anonymous caller it also reads instance anonymous-access policy before forwarding the shared memo ID.
Delegates construction of memo access facts and preserves the shared memo ID.
Separates resource-fact resolution from viewer-specific context construction.
Rejects invalid creator or structure, handles lifecycle checks, and grants when SharedMemoID exactly matches a non-SPACE memo.
Shows the ordinary visibility branches, including denial of a private memo to an inactive or anonymous viewer when the earlier share branch does not apply.
Defines the Allowed predicate used by the handler.
Defines an active viewer and establishes that a nil anonymous viewer is not active.
The read decision depends on runtime resolution of the memo creator and whether the creator is valid.
The resolved context carries the anonymous viewer, instance-level anonymous-access result, exact shared memo ID, and creator/space validity into the read decision.
An anonymous viewer is inactive, so the space-membership lookup is skipped; this is relevant to the anonymous non-SPACE branch.
